title: fix(auth,app-shell): take the organization chain and the metadata preload off the console splash's critical path (objectui#12809)
body:
Fixes #12809
Clause-②: yes

The console splash now waits for the session, the membership answer, `me/permissions` and the metadata the current route reads. It no longer waits for `get-full-organization` or for metadata the route does not read.

## What changed

**The organization chain** (`packages/auth/src/AuthProvider.tsx`, `types.ts`). When the `get-session` answer carries better-auth's `activeOrganizationId`, `AuthProvider` names the active organization from that id and the `organization/list` answer. It asks for the member row (`get-active-member`) at the same time as the list, not after the active organization lands. `get-full-organization` is no longer asked on boot. Every first-paint reader of `activeOrganization` reads only `id`, `name` or `slug`, and the list row carries all three: `actionContextOrg`, `WorkspaceSwitcher`, `CurrentOrganizationIndicator`, the metadata cache scope and the filter scope. The early member answer is taken once, by the first member read for the same organization, and dropped on a switch, a sign-out or an id the list does not confirm. It is not a cache: nothing time-based was added. A session answer without the key (a sign-in response, or a server without the organization plugin) takes the old path. So do mutation callers of `refreshOrganizations`. An organization switch, the ADR-0081 single-membership repair, the stale-id clear (objectui#12698), the session-user-change invariant (objectui#5664), sign-in and sign-out are unchanged, and their existing pins pass unchanged.

**The splash gate** (`packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx`, new `appRouteMetadataReads.ts`). The `scopeMetaReady` preload of `object`, `dashboard`, `report` and `page` is gone. `APP_ROUTE_METADATA_READS` declares, per route, the buckets its element reads at render. Examples: an object list reads `object`; a record page reads `object` and `page`; a dashboard reads `dashboard` and `object`; a redirect reads nothing. The boot splash waits for the current route's buckets only. After the first paint, a route whose buckets have not landed shows a skeleton in the route slot, inside the console chrome, instead of an empty list or a not-found state. A bucket that is refetching keeps the route mounted. A route the host adds through `extraRoutes` waits for all four buckets, as before.

**The route readers.** One gate in `AppContent` replaces a wait in each reader. Without a wait, these readers would draw an empty or not-found state on an empty bucket: ObjectView, ObjectDataPage, RecordFormPage, RecordDetailView (objects), ReportView, DashboardDesignPage, the CreateAppPage and EditAppPage pickers, SearchResultsPage, and AppRootLanding's nav prune. `appRouteMetadataReads-12809.test.ts` reads the route table out of `AppContent.tsx` and fails on a route without a row, so a new route cannot skip its wait.

## What the splash waited for, measured

Setup: hotcrm `objectstack dev --fresh`, behind a local proxy that adds 50 ms to every request on both sides. The console was a production build served by `vite preview`, opened in Chromium via Playwright: sign in, one warm open, then the measured open of `/apps/crm_enterprise/crm_account`. Times are milliseconds from navigation start; three opens per side.

| | main 5d69b0e | this branch |
|---|---|---|
| splash on screen | 598-1498, 571-1327, 650-1554 (756-904 ms) | 615-1243, 671-1467, 670-1344 (628-796 ms) |
| get-session | 515-587 | 534-603 |
| organization/list | 612-698 | 629-721 |
| get-full-organization | 740-1057 | not requested |
| get-active-member | 1068-1171 (after get-full-organization) | 629-716 (beside the list) |
| me/permissions | 1068-1192 | 737-1037 |
| meta/dashboard, meta/report, meta/page | 1198-1338 (preload, gating) | 1043-1151 (chrome reads, not gating) |

The waits after `get-session` went from four serial steps to two:
- main: the list, then `get-full-organization`, then the member row and `me/permissions`, then the dashboard, report and page preload;
- this branch: the list and the member row together, then `me/permissions`.

`me/permissions` used to wait for `get-full-organization` because the console mounts it below `RequireOrganization`, which waits for the organization load to finish. On the branch, slowing one request by 600 ms leaves the splash unchanged for `sys_user_preference`, `me/localization` and `meta/page`; slowing `me/permissions` moves it, as ruled ('me' is on the critical path).

A Vite dev-server open measured 1744 ms on main and 1726 ms on the branch. That interval is dominated by module loading, so the production builds above are the reading.

## Screenshots (light, evidence branch, not merged here)

- Console home after the change (CONTROL that it renders): https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/42c88701243d586710a3a87f53df603c2570ba07/docs/design/findings/12809/console-home-after-12809.png?raw=true
- A dashboard route opened after the first paint, its metadata slowed to 4 s: the skeleton inside the chrome: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/42c88701243d586710a3a87f53df603c2570ba07/docs/design/findings/12809/app-route-skeleton-12809.png?raw=true
- The same route once the metadata landed: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/42c88701243d586710a3a87f53df603c2570ba07/docs/design/findings/12809/app-route-after-skeleton-12809.png?raw=true

## Tests

- `orgChainParallel-12809.test.tsx` (auth): the member row is asked while `organization/list` is still pending; `get-full-organization` is never asked; the active organization is the list row the session names. CONTROLs: a StrictMode replay asks once; a switch re-reads the member row for the new organization; a session without the key takes the old path; a stale id names no organization and clears the stored id; one membership is repaired once.
- `AppContent.splashCriticalPath-12809.test.tsx` (app-shell): real `AuthProvider` and `useWorkspaceAdminStatus` under `AppContent`. The splash leaves after the session, the member row and the route's `object` bucket. It does not wait for `get-full-organization` (whose double never answers) or for the dashboard, report and page buckets. CONTROLs: a later route draws its skeleton inside the chrome, then its content; a refetching bucket keeps the route mounted.
- `appRouteMetadataReads-12809.test.ts` (app-shell): the enumeration, in both directions, plus URL-to-row matching with host routes.

Ablation, one per new pin, each mutation confirmed on disk and each restore confirmed against HEAD with an empty `git diff HEAD`:
- disable the early member ask: 1 test red;
- drop the route-reads term from the splash gate: 1 test red;
- delete the `search` row: 1 test red.

## Evidence, pinned to 82150d0

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/auth test`: exit 0, 34 files, 317 tests.
- app-shell in 8 shards (`pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/ --shard=K/8`; the whole suite exceeds the container's foreground cap): every shard exit 0. 1527 files (1526 passed, 1 skipped); 14395 tests passed, 9 skipped.
- `pnpm exec vitest run apps/console/`: exit 0, 222 files, 2300 tests.
- `type-check` for auth and app-shell: 0.
- `build`: auth, app-shell, the console's dependency closure, and the console: all 0.
- `pnpm check:eager-closure` 0, `check:i18n-keys` 0, `check:i18n-drift` 0, `check:spec-symbols` 0, `check:new-line-citations` 0, `check:test-path-roots` 0, `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` 0.
- eslint on the touched files: 0 errors. It adds 7 `react-hooks/refs` warnings (render-time ref reads in the first-paint latch and the settled-type set) and removes one `set-state-in-effect` warning; lint sets no `--max-warnings`.

## Deviations

- `packages/auth/src/types.ts`: one new optional member, `AuthClientSession.activeOrganizationId`, the type of `useAuth().session`.
- New `packages/app-shell/src/console/appRouteMetadataReads.ts`. It is not exported from the package entry. No route component was edited; the wait lives in `AppContent`, for the reasons under 'The route readers'.
- `useWorkspaceAdminStatus.ts` is unchanged. `me/permissions` is the console host's `ConsolePermissionsScope`, not this hook, and it stays on the critical path.
- Some existing values now resolve sooner, on a session that carries the key: `activeOrganization`, `activeMember`, `isMembershipResolved`, and `isOrganizationsLoading` turning false. `activeOrganization` is now the list row.

## Acceptance notes

- Out of scope and unchanged: the server-side query count of `get-full-organization`, and the cloud control plane's own calls. objectui#12808 already landed as 5d69b0e.
- Observations, not filed: under StrictMode in dev, several boot requests go out twice (production sends one); `MetadataProvider` loads its eager `app` and `view` types one after the other; the recent-items tracker does not record the boot landing when objects are not yet loaded. All three are pre-existing and unchanged here.
